parameters.jsCode: const input=$items('Webhook • Admin Sightings')[0].json.body||{}; const source=['all','ebird','guide'].includes(input.source)?input.source:'all'; const speciesCode=String(input.speciesCode||'').trim(); const days=Math.min(365,Math.max(1,Number(input.days)||30)); const limit=Math.min(10,Math.max(1,Number(input.limit)||10)); const cutoff=Date.now()-days*86400000; const guide=$items('Google Sheets • Read Sightings').map(i=>i.json).filter(r=>r&&r.source==='guide').map(r=>({speciesCode:r.speciesCode,englishName:r.english_name||'',scientificName:r.scientific_name||'',observed_at:r.observed_at,quantity:Number(r.quantity)||1,location_name:r.location_name||'',source:'guide',guide_id:r.guide_id||'',recap_id:r.recap_id||'',seen_or_heard:r.seen_or_heard||'seen'})); const raw=$json.body??$json; const rows=Array.isArray(raw)?raw:[]; const ebird=rows.map(r=>({speciesCode:r.speciesCode,englishName:r.comName,scientificName:r.sciName,observed_at:r.obsDt,quantity:r.howMany||1,location_name:r.locName,latitude:r.lat,longitude:r.lng,source:'ebird',ebird_sub_id:r.subId||'',ebird_obs_id:r.obsId||''})); const merged=(source==='guide'?guide:source==='ebird'?ebird:[...guide,...ebird]).filter(r=>(!speciesCode||r.speciesCode===speciesCode)&&(!r.observed_at||Date.parse(String(r.observed_at).replace(' ','T'))>=cutoff)).sort((a,b)=>Date.parse(String(b.observed_at||0).replace(' ','T'))-Date.parse(String(a.observed_at||0).replace(' ','T'))).slice(0,limit); return [{json:{ok:true,count:merged.length,sightings:merged}}];
